_note: Sources for Form 2 Computer Science (Batches S2-1 and S2-2, Terms 1 and 2). Computed answers use the rules named here.

hardware.ref: Computer hardware: input, output, processing and storage devices (standard ICT textbooks)
hardware.supports: Classification of devices; CPU parts (control unit, ALU, registers), GHz; RAM volatile, ROM non-volatile; secondary storage types.
hardware.checked: Standard content; item banks authored: please check.

artificial-intelligence.ref: Introductory descriptions of artificial intelligence and machine learning (e.g. UNESCO guidance on AI in education, 2023); good practice for prompts
artificial-intelligence.supports: What AI is; machine learning from data; everyday applications; ethical issues (bias, privacy, misinformation and deepfakes, jobs, over-reliance); responsible use; parts of a good prompt.
artificial-intelligence.checked: Authored for Form 2 from general knowledge: please check that the level and examples suit the pupils.

problem-solving.ref: Problem-solving steps (understand, plan, carry out, check), decomposition, algorithms, pseudocode and flowchart symbols, tracing
problem-solving.supports: The order of the steps; flowchart symbols (oval, parallelogram, rectangle, diamond, arrows); traced outputs computed by code (traceAdd, traceDouble).
problem-solving.checked: Standard content; traces computed by code.

system-software.ref: Operating systems, utility software and device drivers
system-software.supports: Functions of an OS; examples (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS); GUI and CLI; utilities (antivirus, firewall, backup, clean-up, compression, defragmenter); drivers.

number-systems.ref: Binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal; bits and bytes; ASCII (A = 65, a = 97, 0 = 48, space = 32) and Unicode
number-systems.supports: Place values and conversions (computed by toBase, fromBase, placeSum, divSteps, bits8, toHex); ASCII codes computed from the character (asciiOf); 2ⁿ values with n bits.
number-systems.checked: Standard; values computed by code and tested.

units.ref: Units of time and of storage (1 byte = 8 bits; 1 KB = 1024 bytes, the school convention)
units.supports: Conversions computed by convertUnit (time) and storageConvert (storage).
units.checked: Computed by code. The 1024 convention is a decision to confirm with the teacher (TR-T05).

internet.ref: Accessing the internet and using a web browser
internet.supports: Devices, connections (mobile data, Wi-Fi, fibre), ISPs (MTN, Orange, Camtel, Nexttel), data units (MB, GB; 1 GB = 1000 MB as used in bundle questions), Mbps; browser parts, URLs, https, .cm, search engines and checking sources.
internet.checked: General knowledge: please check the ISP names.

assistive-tech.ref: Assistive technologies for visual, hearing, physical and learning impairments
assistive-tech.supports: Screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, TalkBack), magnifiers, Braille displays, captions, speech recognition, on-screen keyboards, eye-tracking, sticky keys.

block-programming.ref: Block programming (Scratch): events, sequences, loops, variables, conditions, operators, debugging
block-programming.supports: x after a loop = start + step × repeats (traceAdd); if/else outcomes (traceIf); a regular polygon needs turns of 360 ÷ sides.

digital-identity.ref: Digital identity and digital footprints: authentication, strong passwords, two-step verification, active and passive footprints, managing footprints
digital-identity.supports: Password advice (long, mixed characters), scam awareness, privacy settings.

iot-cloud.ref: Cloud computing, sensors, embedded systems and the Internet of Things
iot-cloud.supports: Cloud services and their advantages and disadvantages; sensor types and uses; microcontroller, sensors and actuators; IoT data flow.

office-software.ref: Spreadsheet, presentation and desktop publishing software
office-software.supports: Cell addresses, ranges, formulas, SUM, AVERAGE, relative references when copying; slide design rules (about 6 lines, at least 24-point text); DTP frames, templates, orientation, poster content.
office-software.checked: Arithmetic computed by the engine; design guidelines are common advice.
